name: Twitter Card Meta Generator
summary: Generate twitter:* meta tags for summary, large image, player, and app cards — with a live preview.
description: Pick a Twitter/X card type and fill title, description, image, site, and creator to get copy-ready twitter:* HTML. Supports player iframe fields and app store ids. Includes a simple card preview and validation tips. Runs locally.

faqs.question: Which card types are supported?
faqs.answer: summary, summary_large_image, player, and app — with the fields each type commonly needs.

faqs.question: Do I need absolute image URLs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Social scrapers expect a publicly reachable absolute HTTPS URL for twitter:image.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
